description: Interior of a subway station platform in a painted, oil-style scene. A silver commuter train with a red front panel pulls into the platform, and a crowd of people in 1970s-style shirts, flared trousers and a knee-length skirt waits and boards. A red brick or tiled wall runs down the left, with high-rise residential towers visible through the station opening and a yellow safety line along the platform edge. No legible text or signage is visible, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.
